title: Paranormal Investigator To Appear At Seymour Public Library
content:
SEYMOUR — Jeff Belanger, Paranormal Investigator, Free and In Person Program, Dead of Winter, Wednesday, December 9, 2026 at 6:30 PM  at the Seymour Public Library in Seymour, CT.

Ready to put a chill into the coldest winter’s day?  This program explores the haunts, legends, and monsters associated with winter. From frozen people to abominable snow beasts, from icy haunts to strange creatures who adapt to freezing temperatures, the Dead of Winter will give you something to shiver about.

Award-winning, Emmy-nominated host, writer, and producer of the New England Legends series on PBS and Amazon Prime, Jeff Belanger also hosts the popular New England Legendsweekly podcast and has lectured at a host of venues. If you want to find out more about Jeff Belanger, check out his website at https://www.jeffbelanger.com/.

Registration is not required for this free program at the library and all are welcome to attend.  Funded by the generosity of a Matthies Foundation grant, this program is considered appropriate for those aged fifteen and above. Seymour Public Library is located at 46 Church St., Seymour, CT 06483. Phone 203-888-3903 for more information. Join us for this fun and seasonal evening you won’t soon forget!
